native_training.route: Meet native prerequisites, then right-click with a water bucket, slime ball and paper in sequence. Charge chakra within eight blocks for 60 seconds per stage; return with paper to finish. Native Ninjutsu Release hosts the learned technique.
Meet native prerequisites including Lightning access. Right-click the teacher, charge chakra nearby for 180 seconds, then return for assessment. Native Ninjutsu Release hosts the learned technique.
Sneak-right-click Jiraiya; complete the native stone-and-water meditation objectives and return to him. See the native guide for current checks.

upstream_limitations: The author advertises 500+ techniques, including original ones; this catalogue reports only independently inspected declarations and does not equate that marketing number with working canon techniques.
Many declarations explicitly return false from isFunctional() or inherit a placeholder base. Unknown declarations remain unverified, not marked playable.
The native guide says Jin Bond has no ordinary training route and Chakra Cloak is incomplete. The addon field dossier and sanctuary victories do not seal beasts or grant native bond.
Wood, Ice, Kurama-clan and Jugo acquisition include unfinished content. Read native learner tooltips and the native guide before choosing a progression goal.

Some weapons are models with ordinary combat statistics; a recognizable name does not guarantee its full anime power. Recipe absence means no recipe was found, not proof that no other acquisition route exists.
Juubi and Reibi learner items exist, but no corresponding beast entity is registered in this build. The nine regular beasts are the verified summonable entity set.
Native /sevenswords is unfinished. The addon market supplies selected genuine item models through original mission-credit rewards.
Ninshu uses its own randomized identity and proficiency systems; the addon story route is separate from native village/clan state.
